_note: Skyglass event items, step 1 (push/254): creates the Skyglass Coffer (weighted cache), the five elemental Tool Pouches (guaranteed kunai x10 + one weighted roll) and the four hunt maps (3 Charts + Signal Beacon; OTHER, tradable, no effect: they become Battle Pyramid entry items later). All HIDDEN. Icons are the final Skyglass event icons (art/skyglass_event_icons/exports, pack pinned at c371a8c; art request docs/handoffs/SKYGLASS_EVENT_ITEM_ICONS_ART_REQUEST.md). Charts are maps of the wreck's own interior (RUL-2026-10-24-026). Rarities and descriptions are drafts for the director. Contents per docs/design/SKYGLASS_LOOT_TABLES.md. Armory Requisition is not here: it needs its Special quest first.

data.name: Chart of the Drowned Foundry
data.description: A waterlogged chart of the Skyglass wreck's keel and lower decks, where the drowned foundry lies. The ship never keeps its shape for long. Bring it to the Battle Arena to follow it while it still holds.

data.description: A Skyglass beacon still tuned to the Silent Bastion. Bring it to the Battle Arena to follow its signal.
